verdict.rationale: Deel's API/MCP docs show contract creation (POST /rest/contracts) and MCP tools like listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest, and calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts, indicating an agent could plausibly initiate onboarding-related actions via API/MCP. However, evidence only demonstrates contractor contract creation and payroll/HR data marketing claims — there is no documented endpoint or MCP tool specifically for creating an employee record, setting compensation, or configuring tax withholding end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit employee-creation API/tool, compensation-setup endpoint, tax-setup automation, and an end-to-end onboarding example combining all three.
